course.title: Unit 4 My Favourite Subject【例句】
course.description: SECTION A Why do you like this subject?

sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？
我最喜欢的科目是数学。
你为什么喜欢数学？
因为它很有趣。

sentences.content: I have history on Tuesday mornings.
sentences.english: I have history on Tuesday mornings
sentences.chinese: 我每周二上午有历史课。
你不喜欢历史吗？
不，这对我来说很难。

sentences.content: What other classes do you have today?
sentences.english: What other classes do you have today ?
sentences.chinese: 你今天还有其他什么课？
我有美术和地理课。

sentences.content: What classes do you have today?
sentences.english: What classes do you have today ?
sentences.chinese: 你今天有什么课？

sentences.content: I have Chinese and maths first.
sentences.english: I have Chinese and maths first
sentences.chinese: 我先上语文和数学课。
你喜欢那些科目吗？

sentences.content: I like Chinese because it's fun, but I don't like maths.
sentences.english: I like Chinese because it's fun , but I don't like maths
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢中文因为它很有趣，但我不喜欢数学。
为什么？

sentences.content: Because maths is boring to me.
sentences.english: Because maths is boring to me
sentences.chinese: 因为数学让我感到无聊。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.chinese: 但每一门学科都很重要。
你最喜欢的课是什么？
体育课，因为它令人兴奋。
你下节课是什么？
历史。这是我最喜欢的科目。
你为什么喜欢它？

sentences.content: It's interesting to learn about the past.
sentences.english: It's interesting to learn about the past
sentences.chinese: 了解过去是件有趣的事。
我最喜欢的科目是英语。

sentences.content: It's useful, and my English teacher is really nice.
sentences.english: It's useful , and my English teacher is really nice
sentences.chinese: 它很有用，而且我的英语老师人真的很好。

sentences.content: I like all the subjects, but my favourite is maths.
sentences.english: I like all the subjects , but my favourite is maths
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢所有的科目，但最喜欢的是数学。
因为我擅长数字。

sentences.content: Can you help me with this subject?
sentences.english: Can you help me with this subject ?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我解决这个科目吗？
当然！
